Messages.Author: Talo...@hotmail.com
Messages.Body:
The rulesbook states that the hand strike is the default, regardless
of range or effect.

Therefore, would an aggravated hand strike at range with rotschreck
cause the opposing vamp to go to torpor?

T

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
Talo...@hotmail.com writes:

> Therefore, would an aggravated hand strike at range with rotschreck
> cause the opposing vamp to go to torpor?

No. The rulings state that the strike must be effectiev at the
current range, too.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Coupe wrote:
>
> Talo...@hotmail.com writes:
>
> > Therefore, would an aggravated hand strike at range with rotschreck
> > cause the opposing vamp to go to torpor?
>
> No. The rulings state that the strike must be effectiev at the
> current range, too.

Correct.

Card text says that the minion must attempt to use aggravated damage
"against a vampire" - not merely against the air in front of him.
